title: Domain Prediction v1.0.0
description: Non-canonical domain classification prediction. Staged to prediction ledger. Promotion to canonical requires authorization gate. Models produce predictions; operators authorize mutations.

schemaVersion.description: Schema version. Breaking changes increment major.

predictionId.description: UUIDv7 unique identifier for this prediction row. Set by database on insertion.

classificationRunId.description: UUIDv7 batch identifier. Groups predictions from one classifier run. Links to atlas_domain_classification_runs.

packetKey.description: Reference to semantic packet. MUST match exactly one row in atlas_packets via packet_key. Immutable.

predictedDomain.description: Predicted domain label (e.g., 'backend_database', 'frontend_ui', 'infrastructure', 'unknown'). Proposed, not canonical.

rawScore.description: Raw model output score. Interpretation depends on classifier (log probability for Naive Bayes, sigmoid for logistic regression, etc).

scoreMargin.description: Difference between top-2 class scores. Indicates prediction confidence. NULL if only one class possible.

calibratedConfidence.description: Confidence after calibration (isotonic regression on validation split). NULL if not calibrated.

classifierKind.description: Classifier algorithm (not model instance). Enables comparison across model versions.

classifierVersion.description: Semantic version of classifier (e.g., '0.1' for prototype, '1.0' for first stable release)

modelSha256.description: SHA-256 hash of model artifact (weights, coefficients, tree structure). Enables reproducibility and audit.

featureSchemaVersion.description: Domain feature schema version used for prediction (e.g., 'atlas:domain:features:v2'). Enables feature versioning.

sourceSnapshotSha256.description: SHA-256 of training/validation snapshot. Enables tracking which data trained the model.

ontologyVersion.description: Ontology schema version at prediction time (e.g., 'atlas:ontology:v4'). Prediction may become invalid if ontology changes.

status.description: Lifecycle state. PREDICTED = raw output. GATED_* = awaiting review/authorization. ACCEPTED = eligible for promotion. REJECTED = dismissed. SUPERSEDED = replaced by newer prediction.

gateReason.description: If status starts with GATED_, reason why (e.g., 'scoreMargin < 0.1', 'modelVersionMismatch', 'predictedDomain=unknown')

authorizedBy.description: User or service that authorized promotion from ACCEPTED to canonical. NULL if not yet authorized.

authorizedAt.description: Timestamp of authorization. NULL if not yet authorized.

promotedToCanonicalAt.description: Timestamp when prediction was promoted to atlas_packets.domain_class. NULL if not yet promoted.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when prediction was created.

metadata.description: Extensible metadata. Classifier-specific fields, confidence breakdown, feature contribution, etc. NOT part of canonical identity.
